phases_note: This SRD has no Implementation Checklist by design (its §13 says so outright: it names where criteria can attach, and declines to write them). Phases are derived from the specification sections and grounded in the existing tree. Each phase files its own ISCs into ISA.md rather than deferring them to a final phase, which is this repo's established pattern.

inherited_conventions.file_ownership: Disjoint per engineer. That run had engineers run NO git commands and the orchestrator own the index. This run uses per-engineer git worktrees instead, so each engineer has its own index and may commit safely; the disjoint-file rule still holds.
inherited_conventions.contracts_ts: src/contracts.ts is READ-ONLY to phase engineers. Schema changes there need an explicit scoped exception from the orchestrator plus a stated compatibility policy for records already on disk. Relevant to Phase 2 (the task envelope).
inherited_conventions.omlx: NEVER 127.0.0.1:8000 or localhost:8000 (local LaunchAgent com.pai.omlx is deliberately unloaded). Fleet oMLX is the LAN peer only.
inherited_conventions.isa_grading: [x] only if something reproducible re-checks it in CI; local-only or self-skipping probes grade [~]. Mutation-prove before grading.
inherited_conventions.ci_pins: The container job pins TOTAL_EXPECTED (a collected-test count) and probe-guard.sh pins the exact names allowed to skip. New tests in that job require updating the pin by the documented hand method.
inherited_conventions.no_ai_attribution: Constitutional in this repo: no Co-Authored-By, no AI/LLM references in commits, PRs, comments or docs.

workflow_override.branch: observer-role — ONE long-lived branch for all five phases
workflow_override.per_phase: engineers -> merge worktrees -> review -> fix issues -> run the full local CI gate green -> next phase. NO per-phase PR.
workflow_override.at_end: one PR for the whole implementation
workflow_override.gate: All tests and CI operations run LOCALLY at the end of each phase and must be green before the next phase starts.
workflow_override.scope: REPO-LOCAL. This override exists because cmux-fleet's CI is unusually heavy (~38 job-minutes per run, ~76 per merged PR) and the repo is now private, so Actions minutes are billed. The ~/.claude/skills/ProjectManager/SKILL.md definition is NOT modified and its default per-phase-PR workflow still stands for every other repo.

phase_1_result.found_beyond_brief: scripts/operations kept its own "tick-1" fallback for resolving pane 1's MODE, separate from DEFAULT_OPERATIONS_WORKERS which builds pane 1's COMMAND. After the default moved the console brought up obs-1 and rendered it as a log tail. Every existing unit assertion stayed green throughout, because the plan was correct for both inputs - it was the input that was wrong.
phase_1_result.method_note: The container suites run against the FIXED tag pifleet/pi-worker:verify and never rebuild, so a mutation under docker/ is invisible until the image is rebuilt AND retagged. Also: pick the tag from `image build`'s own "built <tag>" line, never from `image list --json | .[0]` - a cache-hit rebuild does not refresh creation time, so after restoring a mutation the list's head is still the MUTATED image and the restore silently does not restore.
